name: Location
description: See your tracked location history on a map and timeline, grouped into sessions.

location.tracking.reason: Turn location tracking on or off and choose how often a point is recorded, from the Möbius phone app.

store.tagline: See where your phone has been, on a map.
store.description:
Location shows the history recorded by the Möbius phone app: every point on a map, joined into a track for each trip, with your latest position highlighted. Below the map, a timeline lists each session's points with time, accuracy, speed and altitude, and a link to open any point on the OpenStreetMap website. Drag to move the map, and pinch or scroll to zoom.

Your positions stay on your own Möbius. Only the map background is loaded from OpenStreetMap, through your Möbius: OpenStreetMap sees which area of the map is shown, never your recorded points. Opening a point on OpenStreetMap shares just that one point with their website.

When you open Location in the Möbius phone app, you can turn tracking on or off and choose how often a point is recorded, right from the app. Once on, the phone keeps recording in the background, with your phone's location indicator showing. On other devices, Location shows whether tracking is on but can't change it.
